candidate: Existing posterior H32, independent samples expanded from three to eight
change: Only increase the existing model-sample count. Keep posterior world model, H32, factual learner, persona, retry bank, H2 future recovery, fixed source and actual-world RNG.

criteria.adoption: Not automatic. Every adverse difference and personality behavior requires review; a development pass is insufficient.
criteria.complete: All 10 pairs reach actual terminal under the unchanged 128-turn rules. Missing/partial executions cannot pass.
criteria.family_gate: Every family mean score and conditional increment delta >= -1e-12 versus stable H32. All individual losses retained and diagnosed.
criteria.improvement: At least one of the three concordantly adverse cases improves both score and conditional increment by >1e-12.
criteria.integrity: Frozen source, fixed personality/values, matched actual world random streams, full learner/save-restore replay, fresh controls on the same pinned runtime; no hidden law input to decision.

execution.reason: More hypothetical paths cost more time. These are continuations of the same executions, never fresh attempts or different seeds.

independent_confirmation.allowed_only_after: Complete audited development gate and review, with unchanged candidate
independent_confirmation.gate: All 40 conditions complete. Each family score/conditional mean nonnegative versus stable H32 and original H16; at least one strict gain versus H32. Also retain original adoption gates: positive gambling/resources, all four gambling worlds, at least three gambling worlds improve versus H16. Preserve personality, audit every loss; no acceptance on known cases or thresholds relaxed after outcomes.

limitations: More model samples cannot supply missing information or correct a wrong world law.
The first three seeds are retained; the five additional consecutive seeds are fixed before this study, never selected for favorable actions.
The previous gambling loss includes choices favored by observed beliefs. This study must not claim those losses are necessarily avoidable intelligence defects.
Full development gates and individual review remain mandatory before the reserved forty; no promotion from a local root.
purpose: Same ten known conditions with fresh controls; separate sparse forecast integration from model/personality changes. Not independent confirmation.
